name: Simulation 69
source:
It was a normal life living alongside 3 beautiful women, recovering from a tragic past. Then came the headaches, each one stronger than the one before and messing up your memories. Something is wrong, very wrong. Strange oddities are appearing all around at random moments. It’s like living in a glitching computer...

Our MC is a moody, slick, young man ready to return to college. Uncover the source of this strange phenomenon, meet colorful characters, choose the kind of path you want our MC to take, and enjoy a quirky, humorous, VN with a unique take on the whole genre.
translation:
与三位美丽的女人一起过着正常的生活，从悲惨的过去中恢复过来。然后是头痛，每一次都比前一次更强烈，并扰乱了你的记忆。有什么不对劲，非常不对劲。奇怪的事情在随机的时刻出现在周围。这就像生活在一台出故障的电脑里……

我们的主持人是一位喜怒无常、圆滑的年轻人，准备重返大学。揭开这种奇怪现象的根源，结识丰富多彩的角色，选择你希望我们的主持人走的道路，并享受对整个流派独特的古怪、幽默的VN。
